title: Independent Validation of Energy-Flow Cosmology BAO Predictions: Cross-Survey Transfer from DESI DR2 to BOSS DR12
abstract: Independent cross-survey validation of Energy-Flow Cosmology (EFC) using BOSS DR12 BAO data, applying DESI DR2 best-fit parameters without refitting. The study finds a robust improvement in BOSS DR12 chi-squared (Δχ² = −7.77) under EFC, confirmed via whitening, eigenmode, and diagonal-covariance diagnostics, and shows complementary constraints when combining BOSS with eBOSS.
